gen-gf-gabarito-sora: Gabarito looks drawn with a single nib, its open-cut terminals letting the counters flow outward. Sora follows in a precise geometric sans, and its clean curves give the pair a crisp, deliberate finish.
gen-gf-gabarito-space-grotesk: Expressive and a bit wayward, Gabarito writes its headings as if with one nib, terminals cut open. Space Grotesk then settles in below, its ribbon of constant width and breathing counters giving the pair a steady footing.
gen-gf-metamorphous-manrope: Roomy, regal letters with a high midline and soft stroke shifts make Metamorphous feel like carved ceremony. Manrope, plain and bright, runs beneath it.
gen-gf-oxanium-montserrat: Montserrat reads wide and generous, with big open curves. Under Oxanium's tall, monoline headings, a longer passage would glide along smoothly, each line moving under the eye like drawn wire.
gen-gf-revalia-fs-supreme: Supreme reads crisp and sturdy, its letters held open. Revalia is the one for sprawling, expressive display with its open-curled g and spaced stride, while the plain sans handles the steady, dense text work.
gen-gf-unica-one-switzer: Commanding Unica One has a huge lowercase and daylight in every curve. Shrink it down, though, and its uniform strokes lose their punch, whereas Switzer's wiry, tall-waisted letters hold up fine at larger sizes too.
gen-gf-wallpoet-satoshi: Wallpoet brings bold, tall-rising lowercase with paper showing between the letters, like stencil work. And Satoshi, a plain sans with a soaring x-height and marker-steady line, gives it a friendlier, sturdier partner.
gen-press-start-2p-manrope: Press Start 2P spaces its blocky letters far apart, like cut-outs pinned to a board, with barely visible modulation. Manrope keeps things friendly, a bright plain sans that stays steady.
gen-audiowide-fs-hind: Futuristic Audiowide lays its tall lowercase out like tiles with wide grout lines, no thick-thin shift anywhere. And Hind, a plain sans with steady strokes and capital-sized lowercase, keeps a longer read untroubled.
gen-gf-autour-one-fs-hind: Chunky, round and confident, Autour One has clear channels into every curve and no hairline shifts at all. Hind's sans strokes are as steady as drawn string, which gives the pair a grounded, dependable feel.
